rationale: Measured from the 2026-08-22 clean Docker production build after the pre-beta audit remediation: DSA listing/shop report channel, LCEN imprint page, DSA terms sections, suspension statements of reason, locale-aware SEO metadata, euro price parsing, and ~120 new en/nl message keys. Because the paraglide i18n chunk is statically shared by the entry graph, localized string growth necessarily raises the initial JavaScript budget; the aggregate and largest-chunk ceilings are unchanged and all other metrics remain within their prior caps. Ceilings restore approximately the same fixed proportional headroom as the 2026-08-09 re-baseline (~1.15% raw / ~1.1% gzip on initial JavaScript).
